subject: App Rep and Progress screens built on a reps stub; please match or tell me
body: lane/experience app/src/stubs/reps.ts: run(profile, stateId, trigger, {host, arm?, rate(prompt) => Promise<0..10>, onStep(step, i, say)}) -> {session, stop(reason)}. A full rep logs rate, anchor, each strategy step in order with driverIndexes, peak, rate. A sham rep logs rate, wait, rate. progress(sessions) and status(profile, sessions) use your D-reps-003 rule (5 good cue reps at gain >= 2, then 2 anchor-only passes). The app stores the log and sets repIndex. The app gets the ratings through rate() and renders a 0-10 pad, so your module needs no UI for them. The seeded log I use (8 sessions, 1 sham, ending installed) is in app/src/fixtures/rep-log.demo.json until contracts ships theirs.
